items.title: Man Utd enquire about Toney - Sunday's gossip
items.description: Manchester United enquire about Ivan Toney's availability, Barcelona are tracking Chelsea winger Estevao Willian, Jean-Philippe Mateta is set to leave Crystal Palace in January, plus more.

items.title: AC Milan score three first-half goals to seal derby victory over Inter
items.description: Christian Pulisic, Adrien Rabiot and Diego Moreira score in the first-half to help AC Milan to a 3-1 victory over city rivals Inter Milan in the first Milan derby of the season in Serie A.

items.title: Suzuki makes string of saves before conceding own goal in draw with Fulham
items.description: Nicolas Jackson scored his eighth goal in 10 games but an error from goalkeeper Zion Suzuki meant Aston Villa had to settle for a 1-1 draw at home to Fulham.

items.title: Are De Zerbi's Spurs finding elusive consistency?
items.description: Are Spurs finally finding elusive consistency under Roberto de Zerbi after a third successive Premier League win, asks chief football writer Phil McNulty?

items.title: Watch Saturday's Sportscene highlights on iPlayer
items.description: Highlights from Kilmarnock v St Johnstone and Motherwell v St Mirren.

items.title: Verbruggen spreads belief as impressive Brighton beat Man City
items.description: Goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen was the man of the moment on Saturday afternoon as he produced an impressive individual display to help Brighton beat Manchester City

items.title: Glasner fears he will be next Forest sacking if wins don't follow
items.description: Nottingham Forest head coach Oliver Glasner warns he will be the fifth sacking in just over a year by the club, unless results improve soon.

items.title: More goals for Lankshear, home woes for Hammers - Aaron McLean's EFL Takeaways
items.description: BBC Final Score pundit Aaron McLean looks at the weekend's talking points in the EFL, including Middlesbrough and West Ham United.

items.title: Tottenham mood 'totally different' - De Zerbi
items.description: Tottenham manager Roberto De Zerbi said the mood at the club is "totally different" after picking up a third straight league victory with a 2-0 win over Crystal Palace.

items.title: Sage looking for solutions to Palace form
items.description: Crystal Palace manger Pierre Sage reacts as his side loses a third consecutive league game following their 2-0 defeat by Tottenham.

items.title: Sunderland's paradox - San Siro trip amid relegation battle
items.description: Sunderland were last season's surprise package in the Premier League, but this time they are struggling after Coventry handed them their sixth defeat.

items.title: Spurs beat 10-man Palace to keep up Sage pressure as Eagles fall into drop zone
items.description: Tottenham beat 10-man Crystal Palace 2-0 at home to record a third straight win and maintain the pressure on Eagles boss Pierre Sage, with his side dropping into the relegation zone.
